label: KTB and S4 route frames together entail the S5 route frame
meaning: If the route's modal frame is reflexive and symmetric (KTB) and also reflexive and transitive (S4), it is reflexive and Euclidean (S5): reflexivity from the KTB premise, the Euclidean condition from symmetry and transitivity by the modal-library theorem TruthCore.Modal.symmetric_transitive_implies_euclidean. With the registrations S5 strengthens KTB and S5 strengthens S4, the S5 frame premise says exactly what the KTB and S4 frame premises say jointly. Establishes no frame premise.

strong_version_needed.60795e6e-1fe1-5c55-9718-bc2a22867244: The Euclidean condition needs symmetry, which only the KTB premise supplies; its registered weak version (KT frame) gives reflexivity alone, and reflexivity with transitivity does not give the Euclidean condition (frameStrictness: an S4 frame that is not S5, the two-world order frame).
strong_version_needed.d8d91023-300e-50f4-9cc5-e62f44a1aa04: The Euclidean condition needs transitivity, which only the S4 premise supplies; its registered weak version (KT frame) gives reflexivity alone, and reflexivity with symmetry does not give the Euclidean condition (frameStrictness: a KTB frame that is not S5, the reflexive symmetric non-transitive path).
